name: Production Distro RC18
source: RC17 final audit; maestro-managed RC18 planning
goal: Plan and execute an AIOS-body isolated installed-system image install/update/rollback drill without giving authority to mirror frontend, Nginx/TLS, remote signer, object storage, remote dispatch, private signing material, support upload, recovery execution, host boot state, production rings, TUI projections, shell output, or model replay.
core_thesis: AIOS becomes closer to a distributable OS when exact install/update/rollback evidence moves from repo-local artifacts into a disposable installed-system image or VM boundary while the host and production rings remain untouched.
non_goals: Do not build mirror frontend, nginx, TLS, remote signer, object storage, or remote dispatch infrastructure in RC18 body tasks.
Do not read, copy, print, hash, move, or reference private signing material.
Do not claim GA production readiness.
Do not mutate host rootfs, host active slot metadata, host boot metadata, active artifact set, or production rings.
Do not upload support bundles, execute recovery services, or dispatch remote fleet actions.
primary_acceptance: RC18-050 final closeout audit closes RC18 as a non-GA AIOS-body isolated installed-system drill milestone.

The plan covers disposable image boundary, baseline boot-state projection, image-boundary fail-closed fixtures, isolated install, isolated update, rollback preconditions, isolated rollback, support/recovery evidence, consumer smoke, and final audit.

The plan preserves AIOS-body-only scope and keeps mirror frontend, nginx/TLS, signer infrastructure, object storage provisioning, remote dispatch, private signing material, support upload, recovery execution service, host boot mutation, and production ring mutation out of scope.
The plan keeps production_ready_claim=false until final audit and still forbids GA claims.
